Profile: SMB martech startup building a content generation platform for small agencies. Inbound from blog post + marketing partnership. Wants hosted, self-serve path; not ready for Dedicated/Private.

Call notes (03/02):
- Attendees: Aaron Park (Head of Eng), Priya Nair (PM), Maya Chen (AE), Diego Alvarez (SE).
- Use case: large-scale template-driven content (social, subject lines, cold email variants) + occasional long-form. High request volume with many short prompts.
- Traffic: current beta ~ 20-50 req/s, target peak 100-200 req/s during campaigns. Monthly token estimate: 3-8M tokens initially, scales with new customers.
- Latency SLO: ideally <=800ms p95 for short template expansions; can tolerate up to 1500ms for long-form.
- Cost sensitivity: "Token cost is killing our margins" — direct quote from Aaron. Wants clear per-unit economics; batching & caching are priority.
- Model preference: prefer small/efficient open models (7B/13B quantized) to keep cost low; open to Redwood model catalog recommendations and automatic fallbacks to cheaper variants.
- Routing/fallback: want policy to route by cost/latency; fallback to cheaper model during peak. Also asked about region routing (NA primary).
- Security: SSO/SAML for team access, audit logs for user actions. No strict residency requirements today.

Technical ask / PoC scope:
- 2-week PoC on Hosted API using sample production traffic (we provide traffic replay). Key goals: measure cost delta with batching, validate prefix/KV caching for repeated templates, confirm latency under p95 target.
- Provide recommended batching config and quantization suggestions; run comparison vs OpenAI baseline provided by customer.
- Deliverables: cost-per-1M-tokens estimate under suggested config, p95 latency numbers, simple dashboard showing cache hit rate.
